data.name: 2 Hour Small Group Private Tour
data.headline: Private, captain-led customizable boat tour around Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands with a Florida-certified naturalist guide.
data.description: Enjoy a private boat tour of Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands with your own captain and a Florida-certified naturalist guide. Design your ideal outing—sightseeing, local history, eco-focused exploration, dolphin watching, or dedicated shelling—then relax while the crew handles navigation and local insights. The experience is tailored to your group’s interests, offering a flexible, immersive way to see mangroves, islands, and wildlife with the privacy of a chartered vessel.
data.highlights:
* Private boat with your own captain
* Florida-certified naturalist guide
* Customizable tour options: sightseeing, history, eco-tour, dolphins, shelling
* Explore Marco Island and the Ten Thousand Islands

meeting_point.instructions: We are located ACROSS THE STREET from Stan's Idle Hour in Goodland. Our boats are behind our big banner and flags on the private dock. Parking is free.

data.cancellation_notes:
- Full refund if canceled 48+ hours before the tour.
- Cancellation insurance is available for any tour or ticket.
- No refunds for cancellations within 48 hours or late arrivals.
- Partial refund if the tour ends early for weather or safety reasons.
- Rescheduled tours can be subject to a rescheduling fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
- Any canceled tours can be subject to a fee of $25 per ticket or $100 per private tour.
data.check_in_details:
- Free parking is available across the street from Stan's Idle Hour Restaurant in the gravel lot behind the white fence. 
- Boats are located on the private dock behind the company banner and flags. 
- Please use the bathrooms at Stan's (yellow building) before boarding.
data.disclaimers:
No restroom on board; guests should use the facilities at Stan's Idle Hour Restaurant before boarding. 
Alcohol is allowed but red wine is prohibited. 
Gratuities for captain and crew are not included.
